sentences.text: It is further submitted that the petitioner had love affair with the victim girl as per the FIR but the victim got married to another person and out of their wedlock, two children were born.

It is also submitted that since after the marriage, the victim has been continuing her relationship with the petitioner and subsequently when the husband of the victim came to know about the fact, a false FIR has been lodged.
On the other hand, Mr. Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State has opposed in granting the privilege of pre-arrest bail to the petitioner stating that there is allegation against the petitioner that he had committed sexual assault towards the victim and submits that the bail prayer of the petitioner may not be considered.
I have considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties.
It appears that the victim is a major girl and had relationship with the petitioner on earlier occasion.

Subsequently, she got married to another boy and now she is the mother of two children and in spite of that, when the petitioner called her, she went to meet the petitioner and it is alleged that the petitioner had committed sexual assault towards the victim near forest area.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties as well as the averments made in the petition, this Court is of the view that till a Page No.# 3/3 final decision is taken on perusal of the case diary, the petitioner, above-named be granted the interim protection till the next date fixed.

Accordingly, it is provided that in the event of arrest of the petitioner, named above, in connection with Bagribari P.S. Case No. 62/2023, registered under Sections 376(1)/354D of IPC, he shall be released on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- with a suitable surety of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the arresting authority.

The direction for pre-arrest bail is subject to the conditions that the petitioner:
(a) shall appear before the Investigating Police Officer within ten days from today and shall co-operate with the investigation;
(b) shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer.
List on 08.12.2023 for production of case diary along with statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. and medical report, if any.
